articles.title: Gujarat CM fast-tracks tender process, sets maximum 66-day deadline
articles.description: Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel has cut the tender approval process from 120 days to a maximum of 51-66 days to fast-track development. The move, which also reduces tender validity to 90 days, aims for faster project commencement and transparency.

articles.title: India News | Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel Sets 51-66 Day Deadline for Tender Approvals
articles.description: Get latest articles and stories on India at LatestLY. Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel has introduced strict timelines for the tender approval process, directing departments to complete approvals within a maximum of 51 days for tenders involving only financial bids and 66 days where pre-qualification and technical and financial bids are required. The tender validity period has also been reduced from 120 to 90 days.
